transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in today?

I guess... well, there was an issue at work. At a staff meeting. 

I just got a little worked up, I suppose. I started... acting out this whole fall-prevention drill. Moving the chairs around, waving my arms. Folks kept telling me to sit down, but I... I couldn't seem to stop. So, they wanted me to come in.
Have you ever felt like you’re seeing or hearing things that others don’t, or had thoughts that others seem unable to understand?

I don't know about thoughts that people don't understand. But... I guess sometimes I hear things. 

Like... when I'm alone. Down the hallway at work, or... or even just at home, near the laundry room. I'll hear someone call my name. Or I'll hear one of the residents yelling for help. It sounds real. Clear as day. But... then I go check, and there's nobody there.
Have you ever had strong beliefs or ideas that other people don't seem to share or understand, even when they tell you they aren't true?

I don't... I don't know if I'd call it a strong belief. It's just... something I notice. 

Even when I'm just doing my job, keeping my head down... I know my supervisor and a few of the others are watching me. Keeping notes. They make these little comments, like they're testing me. Trying to build a case that I'm... that I'm not safe to be around the seniors. They say they aren't, but... I know what I see.
Do you believe that others are deliberately trying to harm you, control you, or that events around you have special meaning directed at you?
I don't think anyone's trying to... harm me. No. Just the notes they keep. I don't know about special meanings or anything like that. Just what I see at work.
Do you ever feel like thoughts are being put into your mind, or that ordinary events or objects have special meanings that are directed at you personally?
No... I don't really know what you mean by that. My thoughts are just mine. And like I said before... I haven't noticed any special meanings or anything. Just regular things.
Do you ever feel like people are talking about you, even when they aren't, or that their actions are somehow related to you, even if they don’t seem to be?
No. I mean... just what I said before, about work. With the notes and the comments. Outside of that... I don't really pay attention to what other people are doing. It's just normal stuff.
Have you ever felt that certain actions or events happening around you were secretly connected to you, even if they didn’t seem to involve you directly?
No... I feel like you keep asking me the same thing. Like I said, it's just the notes at work. I don't... I don't see secret connections in things. It's just regular life.
Do you hear these sounds or your name being called even when you’re not at work, such as when you’re out running errands or visiting someone else’s home?

Not when I'm out running errands, no. Just... well, sometimes at home. Like if I'm by the laundry room. I'll hear my name, or... a resident calling for help. It sounds clear as day. But when I check, there isn't anybody there. And... sometimes in the hallway when I'm alone. That's it, really.
When you hear your name being called or someone asking for help at home, does this happen in other parts of your house besides the laundry room, or only in specific places?
I don't know. Just... mostly around there. And the hallway, like I said. I haven't really noticed it anywhere else.

When you hear these voices calling your name or asking for help, are there any actual sounds happening in the environment that might explain them, or do they happen even when everything around you is quiet?
It's usually quiet. I just... I already told you about this. I'm alone in the hallway, or by the laundry room, and I hear them. Clear as day. But nobody's there. That's all.

When you hear these voices or notice people watching you, do you ever feel like these events are trying to tell you something important about yourself or your job, even if others wouldn’t see it that way?

I don't know about... telling me something important. It's just... I know what's happening. Even when I'm just sitting there, feeling fine, I know they're watching. My supervisor, a couple of the others... they're taking notes on me. Little comments they make, they're testing me. They're trying to prove I'm not safe around the seniors. I just... I know they are.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts are being controlled by an outside force, or that things happening around you are meant specifically to send you a message?
No... no, nothing like that. Nobody's controlling my thoughts. I just... I just know what they're doing at work. That's it.
Do you ever feel like things people say or do, even if they don't seem to involve you, are actually about you or meant to send you a message?
I just... I don't think so. I mean, I already told you about the people at work. But other than that... no. I don't really pay attention to what other people are doing if it doesn't involve me.
Do you ever feel that the things your coworkers say or do, even when they don’t seem to involve you directly, actually have something to do with you or are meant to send you a message?
I mean... I don't know about sending messages. Like I said, I just know they're watching me and taking notes. That's all. I don't know what else to tell you.
Do you ever feel that people are watching or talking about you in places other than work, like when you're out in public or at someone else's home?
No. Just at work. I keep to myself mostly, anyway.
Do you ever feel that the way your coworkers act, even when they don’t seem to involve you, is actually a way of targeting or criticizing you?
I... no. I don't think so. I just... I already told you what they're doing. They watch me. They write things down. I don't know why you keep asking it different ways. It's just what I said.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts are not entirely your own, or that someone is trying to put thoughts into your mind?
No. I don't... my thoughts are just mine. I don't know what you mean by that.
